snippet.title: HoMM III: Day of Reckoning Teaser (shown at h3gg) + Forge Music by Paul Anthony Romero
snippet.description:
Enjoy this teaser of Day of Reckoning, a fan-made expansion for Heroes of Might and Magic III. Originally shown at the T25 Championship hosted by h3gg. Forge town theme music made by Paul Anthony Romero, music other than that made by AmiDaDeer.  

Social Media: 
Facebook: https://facebook.com/homm3DoR
